skills.name: Mở đầu theo nội dung
skills.rule: Use the opening source idea as a short hook; do not add promises or insert a silent intro. Keep original speech.

skills.name: Nhấn từ khóa
skills.rule: Use at most one source-based phrase per camera scene; briefly accent its last two words. Do not animate entire subtitles.

skills.name: Zoom vào rồi trả khung
skills.rule: Alternate gentle eased zoom accents with calm camera intervals; never simulate a second camera angle or crop faces.

skills.name: Danh sách hiện lần lượt
skills.rule: Reveal 2-5 grounded list items one at a time; only use source concepts. Allow time for the last item to be read.

skills.name: Minh họa bằng tài nguyên thật
skills.rule: Prefer relevant uploaded assets with quiet motion. Do not claim a conceptual graphic is product footage or borrow reference footage.

skills.name: Chuyển động vào cảnh mềm
skills.rule: Use short ease-out slide/fade entries without flashes, spins or voice cuts. Preserve total duration and scene boundaries.

skills.name: Số liệu đúng lời
skills.rule: Emphasize only numbers, units and prices present in the current speech. Never invent discounts, crossed-out prices or percentages.

skills.name: Kết video đúng yêu cầu
skills.rule: Use a closing action only when it exists in the closing speech; do not invent links, countdowns, scarcity or guarantees.

skills.name: Khoảng nghỉ thị giác
skills.rule: Return to the speaker between explanatory cards. Keep captions, logo and main heading in separate safe areas.

skills.name: Âm thanh nhấn nhẹ
skills.rule: Keep voice dominant; quiet SFX on relevant graphics only. Respect no-sound and no-effects requests.
